title: Mosque of Ibn Tulun
visualBrief: Individual medium-fi Mosque of Ibn Tulun:large pale arcaded court/deep prayer range,pointed bays with smaller spandrel fields and selected parapet crest,open square fountain pavilion/stepped octagonal drum/ochre dome and the independent minaret with square wrapping ramp,cylindrical drum,two smaller upper stages and round cap. Three current mapped outlines remain fixed;retained40.44m minaret fact separated from approximate subdivisions and ambiguous92m facts. Six existing shared256² graphs,seven groups,four authored browser levels.
